decisions.reason: Changing KiCad 3D-model references to project-relative paths does not alter BOM completeness, part-number, or board-specific BOM requirements.
The model-path portability change does not affect the requirement to place QR identification on each board.
Portable 3D-model references do not change the requirement to validate component orientations in the JLCPCB assembly configuration.
The source decision changes local KiCad asset references, not the actors, method, grouping, or other rules for configuring JLCPCB orders.
The required Gerber, drill, and pick-and-place exports remain unchanged; the source only changes references used for KiCad 3D models.
Changing machine-local 3D-model paths does not alter component availability, compatible-alternative, or procurement policies.
The integrated board's connectors remain through-hole; the source changes only how 3D-model files are referenced.
Project-relative 3D-model references do not affect the lead-free manufacturing requirement.
The source decision does not alter connector-pin labeling targets or silkscreen locations.
The charge-status LED circuit, connector, resistor, and population rules are independent of KiCad 3D-model path portability.
The path correction restores portable 3D visualization but does not change any stated enclosure geometry, accommodation, assembly, airflow, or retention requirement.
The interboard power topology, connector types, and pin rules remain unchanged by the 3D-model reference strategy.
